# cited entity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:citedEntity`](gmeow-citedEntity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/citedEntity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)

The creative work that is cited — a [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md), [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md), [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md), or [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md). Functional per relator: one cited entity per [`CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md).
